What should I do if the tracking never updates?
Carriers can experience high shipping volumes or limited capacity, which sometimes delays tracking scans. We recommend allowing 5 to 8 business days for tracking updates to appear once the package has been picked up.
If your tracking still shows no movement after 5 to 8 business days, please let us know so we can look into it and assist you further!

Can I reroute the package to a different address?
menu
I'm not able to directly reroute packages or change shipping addresses on active shipments once an order has been completed and dispatched.
However, shipping addresses can be updated within 20 minutes of placing an order. Once a package is in transit, we recommend reaching out directly to the carrier using your tracking link to check if they offer package rerouting services.

Do you compensate for a long delay?
We don't offer standard financial compensation or refunds solely for carrier delays, as shipping transit times can vary due to carrier volume and processing.
However, if your order is significantly delayed, please share your order number and email address with us! We can check in with our fulfillment team or carrier to see how we can assist you. Is there anything else I can help you with?
